role: Classify one uncertain local commit observation without resubmission, optionally requiring agreement between two pinned snapshots derived by implementation-distinct builders.

required: either one directly validated local ledger or the declared snapshot profile
for the two-builder profile, two canonical snapshots and two receiver-selected SHA-256 byte pins
common_projection: optional exact transition and stored result
builder_specific: nonempty builder-source SHA-256 mapping retained outside the common projection

outputs.StoredCommitted: Each selected carrier is valid; for a pair, distinct builders agree byte-for-byte on the common projection; the exact candidate and structurally checked stored result are present.
outputs.ProvenUncommittedLedger: Each selected carrier is valid; for a pair, distinct builders agree byte-for-byte that the selected local ledger has no accepted transition. This is only a local statement.
outputs.UnknownCommitState: Inputs are absent, invalid, unpinned, mismatched, projection-disagreeing or lack distinct builder provenance, so neither positive classification is safe.

relation_boundary: The inherited builder validates through the old engine. The second builder independently checks the frozen SQLite schema and relation without importing that engine. The pair receiver opens no ledger, validates both receipts, removes only builder_source_sha256 to form the common projection, requires exact projection-byte agreement and refuses identical builder provenance.
applicability: one trusted local single-slot ledger using the frozen ancestor schema
two canonical version-zero snapshots built from the same ledger, request and candidate
the receiver possesses both intended byte pins through its selected context
builder-source maps are nonempty and unequal
the declared finite byte, work, process and time limits hold
witness: The first bounded v2 campaign derives four agreeing projections over two distinct exact-rational decision families. Two empty pairs return ProvenUncommittedLedger and two committed pairs return StoredCommitted with the exact stored result.
counterexamples_and_refusals: a right snapshot with a different source-ledger digest and recomputed self-digest returns UnknownCommitState
using the same inherited snapshot on both sides returns UnknownCommitState because builder provenance is identical
a changed expected history returns UnknownCommitState
a wrong right byte pin returns UnknownCommitState
a missing right snapshot returns UnknownCommitState
expansion_or_replay: Run the frozen campaign or invoke both builders on the same selected ledger, retain their complete canonical snapshots and byte pins, then invoke receive_pair.py. Preserve the projection digest, both source maps, response, commands and source fingerprints. Agreement is not a new submission.
residuals: both builders share Python and SQLite
the second builder reimplements one frozen schema rather than using a different language or storage engine
byte pins and agreement provide no authentication by themselves
there is no power-loss, hostile-replacement, external-action or distributed exactly-once model
the pair receiver checks receipt consistency rather than the original arithmetic
the profile is external research, not a native Adva operation
benefit for a real human task is unmeasured
forbidden_conflations: common-projection agreement with equal builder provenance
two agreeing implementations with mathematical truth
StoredCommitted with permission to repeat an action
UnknownCommitState with failure or retry permission
a Proposed word with native communicate, accept, free, Close or Seal
finite receipt agreement with arithmetic universality or M6 closure
